runtime: WSL Containers wslc 3.0.5.0; cached image; --pull never; --network none; ephemeral --rm containers; source bind read-only; evidence bind writable; private tmpfs /tmp; bounded cpus=2 and memory=4g. wslc run exposes no read-only-root option, so root filesystem is not claimed read-only.
hypothesis: The current-main increase of supervised XRes disconnect timeout from 0.15s to 0.5s prevents the optimized Xvfb caller from returning UNKNOWN solely because the 0.15s bound expires before the server reply.
decision_rule: A scoped pass requires both test processes exit 0, Xvfb provenance, independent task oracle true for the fresh operation and false for contaminated old operation, independent release readback neutral, all late-horizon keys up, and no replay of the old generation. Preserve all failures and UNKNOWN outcomes without retry.
limits: One normal and one optimized synthetic Xvfb pair on WSLc. This is not MAP01/live GUI, provider-token/latency matched economics, reliability rate, or Research Preview acceptance.
